summary: iter66 — Full backend + frontend verification of 4 new features: (1) AGENT SENTINEL, (2) LAUNCH EMAIL BLAST, (3) PASSWORD SELF-SERVICE, (4) ROUTE OPTIMIZER + owner-sidebar regression. Backend: 17/17 pytest cases pass (100%). Verified sentinel /status + /scan + /alerts + /deployments (2 built-ins seeded); bogus-deployment flow end-to-end: added `TEST_bogus_*` deployment with unresolvable URL, POST /scan marks it 'down', /status.banner becomes non-null (severity=critical), /alerts contains SEN-* with fingerprint 'deploy:<id>' + severity 'critical', ack works, DELETE deployment auto-resolves the alert; dispatcher gets 403 on POST /deployments (require_role('owner')). Launch blast /preview returns subject + HTML containing launch_card_wide.png + /get-quote link + recipient_count; /recipients deduped; POST /send {test_to} returns queued_awaiting_key=1 (Resend key absent, expected — MOCKED); subset /send with 1 email works; dispatcher gets 403 (require_role('owner')). Change-password full cycle on Doug: wrong current → 401, short new (<8) → 400, valid change to DougTest-2026-New! → 200, OLD password fails login (401), NEW password logs in → 200, then RESTORED back to seed 'Griffin-Graham-2026!' → verified doug login=200 post-cycle; admin bearer test_session_admin_1 (google-only, no password_hash) → 400 'This account signs in with Google'. Route optimizer geocode Chicago (lat 41.8, lon -87.6 ✓), MSP→CHI route returns 409.8 mi + ~6h drive_hours + geometry array with Leaflet [lat,lon] ordering; save with rate=$500 → verdict='NO-GO' + net_profit<=0, save with rate=$1500 → verdict GO/CAUTION, GET /loads includes saved, DELETE /loads/{id} works. Frontend Playwright (2 sessions): (session A, admin) Route Optimizer page renders → origin+dest geocode → 'Route it' → miles=409.8 → rate=$1500 shows verdict=GO net=$997.21 → save → history card visible; Launch Blast iframe + toggle-all + test-send toast; Sentinel page + 3 KPI cards + alerts feed + add bogus dep via UI + scan → NAV to /dashboard → red banner 'TEST_UI_bogus_iter66 is DOWN' visible with data-testid sentinel-red-banner + banner-message + banner-link + banner-dismiss → cleanup deleted bogus dep; ChangePasswordDialog opens with mismatched confirm shows toast 'New passwords do not match'. (session B, daniel/owner) Login via /api/auth/login returns session_token, stored in localStorage → sidebar shows Agent Sentinel + Route Optimizer + Launch Email Blast + owner badge, hides 'Admin · Users' (owner rule); daniel can access /sentinel, /route-optimizer, /launch-blast (no Admin-Required shield). Zero regressions, zero issues.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/agent_sentinel.py _sweep uses a boolean `sweeping` flag that races on high-concurrency calls (two concurrent /scan requests can both read False before either sets True). Not a correctness issue (upstream state is idempotent), but under heavy manual scan bursts a second call returns stale-snapshot instead of running. Consider asyncio.Lock. Non-blocking.

routes/agent_sentinel.py bg_loop calls asyncio.get_event_loop() inside a running-loop context — works today but is deprecated in Python 3.12+ (should be asyncio.get_running_loop()). Cosmetic — the loop still starts fine.

routes/agent_sentinel.py: DELETE /deployments/{id} correctly rejects built-ins via `builtin: false` filter (returns 404), but the 404 message says 'Deployment not found (built-ins cannot be removed)' — ambiguous whether the ID is missing OR built-in. Consider distinguishing.

routes/route_optimizer.py hardcodes public OSRM (`https://router.project-osrm.org`) and Nominatim — no fallback if either is throttled/down. Both endpoints correctly return 502 on failure. For prod, consider caching successful geocodes to reduce load on public OSM (usage policy asks for <1 req/sec).

routes/route_optimizer.py compute_margin verdict for `rpm >= 2.0 and margin_pct >= 15` = GO; my test with rate=$1500, miles=410, cpm=$0.55, mpg=6.5, fuel=$4 → rpm=$3.66, margin=66% → correctly GO. But the CAUTION branch's reason string when both rpm<2 AND margin<15 concatenates awkwardly (`Profitable but thin — rate-per-mile below $2.00. margin below 15% (14.3%).`). Cosmetic.
routes/launch_blast.py: send() logs 'Launch blast: X sent, Y queued, Z failed' but does NOT log the invoking user's email — worth adding for audit.
server.py change_password: after successful change, deletes ALL other sessions except the current token — good UX. Verified with token from Bearer header AND cookie fallback path (line 519-523).

server.py change_password: does NOT rate-limit — could be abused for password brute-forcing via a stolen session token. Consider adding a per-user rate limit similar to /api/auth/login. Non-blocking (session token itself gates it).
SentinelBanner.jsx polls /sentinel/status every 60s — during the bogus-deployment test the banner appeared within 3s of navigating to /dashboard (initial poll). Good.
ChangePasswordDialog.jsx frontend validates client-side match (new==confirm) BEFORE hitting the API — matches shown as toast. Good UX + reduces server load.

context_for_next_testing_agent: All 4 features (Agent Sentinel + Launch Email Blast + Password Self-Service + Route Optimizer) work end-to-end. Reusable test file: /app/backend/tests/test_iter66_sentinel_blast_routing.py — 17 tests, ~12s runtime. Watch out for: (1) OSRM/Nominatim public endpoints — occasionally return 502, tests skip gracefully. (2) Doug's brute-force login lockout — 5 wrong passwords per ip:email = 15-min ban; the change-password full-cycle test hits login 1x for wrong-old + 1x for new + 1x restore = 3 login attempts, safe within budget. If retesting frequently within 15 min, use daniel instead. (3) Sentinel red banner polls /status every 60s — test used a fresh scan+immediate navigate, banner appeared in <3s because /dashboard fires its own initial fetch. (4) SentinelBanner.jsx dismiss button (data-testid sentinel-banner-dismiss) uses sessionStorage to hide the banner for the session — clearing sessionStorage re-shows if alert still open. (5) Change-password endpoint deletes all OTHER sessions of the user (keeps current one) — so after doug cycles his password his admin bearer stays valid but other doug sessions get 401. Preserved: `password_self_set: true` flag on doug's user doc after cycle.
